transfer.stem: Which notes keep the question, the drawing order and the pattern rule correct?
transfer.passage:
Plans for the school workshop
We will begin with the safest design. Our teacher asks us to finish the drawing before adding colour. Finishing comes first; this instruction does not say the drawing is already done. We ask, "Can we complete the bridge before the bell?" That is a question about what we can achieve, not a report that the bridge has been completed.
We want to end the discussion with one clear decision. This does not mean every person has already agreed on every issue. We can continue our walk after a short rest, so the rest comes before we resume walking.
Our pattern task says, "Create a pattern using only three shapes." We may repeat a shape: the rule limits the total to three and does not require three different kinds. We also plan to build a shelter for small birds. The group will develop a safer way to cross. Those are plans for future work; they do not prove that construction is finished or that the crossing has no risk.

options.text: The bridge is already complete; colour comes first; use three different kinds of shapes.
Completion is still a question; draw before colouring; use just three shapes.
Completion is still a question; colour before drawing; use just three shapes.
Completion is still a question; draw before colouring; use four shapes.

answer.display: Completion is still a question; draw before colouring; use just three shapes.
